description: Per-lesson visual style defaults for KML book generation. Palettes, flows, and energy use only kml/tools/palette.json. Modes use STYLE_PROFILES keys; surfaces use SURFACE_PROFILES keys from kml/tools/generate_image_prompts.py. paint_density matches production default. Lessons are assigned with weighted variation (fixed seed) plus rare optional special_state markers.

palettes: warm red and orange with ivory strokes
deep indigo and muted gold with cool ivory strokes

families.title: Warm foundational family
families.notes: Warm, simple, inviting impasto language; ivory-friendly light.

families.title: Earth / organic family
families.notes: Grounded mineral greens and umber; tactile, slow growth.

families.title: Cool contemplative family
families.notes: Restrained cool greys and indigo; spacious, inward-looking.

families.title: Dramatic high-contrast family
families.notes: Deep value range; ember accents against charcoal and violet.

families.title: Luminous depth family
families.notes: Jewel-like turquoise and gold against cool depths.

families.title: Twilight atmosphere family
families.notes: Violet–copper oxidation; turbulent but controlled skies.

families.title: Tempered warmth family
families.notes: Return to warmth with matured contrast and earth anchors.

families.title: Shadow earth family
families.notes: Darker atmospheric middle; umber and charcoal as pressure.

families.title: Mist cool family
families.notes: Pale cool ivory fog; subtle movement and reduced saturation feel.

families.title: Voltaic contrast family
families.notes: Advanced sparks: ember, turquoise, and violet in sharp dialogue.

families.title: Polychrome synthesis family
families.notes: Long-form richness: rotate full vocabulary with disciplined cadence.

families.title: Mastery return family
families.notes: Cohesive KML identity: museum poise with painterly warmth echoes.

families.title: Coda coherent family
families.notes: Closing arc: converge on signature warmth–indigo–ivory harmony.
